name: Almond Extract
siboNotes: Pure almond extract is typically well-tolerated as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates, but check labels to avoid added high FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Use pure almond extract rather than imitation versions which may contain high FODMAP additives
A little goes a long way - start with 1/4 teaspoon in recipes
Store in a cool, dark place to maintain flavor potency
Check ingredient labels for wheat-derived alcohol or high FODMAP sweeteners
nutritionalHighlights: Virtually calorie-free in typical serving sizes
Provides intense almond flavor without FODMAP content
